title: Alien
description: Hunt an alien through your spaceship's air vents, and trap it by closing junctions. My reskin and remix of Gregory Yob's Hunt the Wumpus.
versionOrder: Inferred development sequence, not established dates. Both versions are on tape22b: v01 (saves 6-7) precedes v02 (saves 8-9) in save order, and v02 contains v01's game with additions. Tape numbers alone do not establish chronology.

versions.label: Early save · before the remix
versions.note: An earlier save: Hunt the Wumpus with the Alien words but none of the remix (no title, no closing junctions, fixed junction numbers).
versions.unavailableReason: Source only. On this site the Level II BASIC player runs v02, the latest version; this listing and payload remain downloadable.

versions.label: Alien
versions.note: Alien as played on this site, with its printed spelling corrected (corrected/): the title with the film’s tagline, backstory, shuffled junction numbers, and closing junctions to trap the alien.
